summary: Iteration 3 validates 3 new features: (1) Portfolio Zoom Viewer, (2) Share Artist button, (3) Bookings Reminder Banner. Backend regression: 34/34 tests PASSED (backend_test.py 16/16 + test_new_features.py 18/18) — no regressions from the additive frontend changes. Frontend (390x844 mobile viewport, signed in as demo@inked.dev): (a) Portfolio grid on artist detail renders 4 items with testID portfolio-item-0..3 including maximize hint icon; tapping opens the full-screen [data-testid='image-viewer'] with X close (viewer-close), prev/next chevrons (viewer-prev/viewer-next), and caption in the exact format 'X / N · ARTIST NAME' — verified '1 / 4 · KAI NAKAMURA' initially and '2 / 4 · KAI NAKAMURA' after next; close returns to detail. (b) Share button [data-testid='artist-share-button'] visible in top-right group alongside artist-heart-button and message-artist-button; click succeeds (no crash) — on web the navigator.share fallback path executes silently in headless Playwright (permissions/no user gesture) but the Share.share fallback is also wired. (c) Reminder banner: seeded a booking for TOMORROW (demo user) and an additional booking 5 days away for negative-test. The bookings tab shows exactly 1 red banner [data-testid='reminder-<id>'] on the TOMORROW row with text 'TOMORROW — GET READY', and NO banner on the 5-days-away Mara Voss row — confirming the ≤3-day rule. Older bookings (Feb/Mar 2026) automatically fall into past so are hidden from upcoming (correct). Regression spot-checks: sign-in flow, featured card, artist detail heart, portfolio grid, book-session CTA all render correctly. Stripe placeholder key still 'sk_test_emergent' — mock path validated by backend tests (mock_ session id, mock-confirm marks paid, cross-user 404).

critical_code_review_comments: ImageViewer.tsx: ZoomableImage defines full gesture/animation logic then early-returns on Platform.OS==='web' — hooks (useSharedValue etc.) are declared unconditionally so this is safe, but the file could be split into ZoomableImage.native.tsx / ZoomableImage.web.tsx to keep reanimated/gesture-handler out of the web bundle.
ImageViewer uses Dimensions.get('window') at module load — will not update on rotation/resize. Consider useWindowDimensions() inside the component for correct sizing across orientation changes.
shareArtist casts navigator to any — fine; Web Share API also requires https + user gesture, which is met by user-tap in real UI.

Reminder rule uses local device time (new Date()) with the raw ISO date+'T00:00:00'; parses as local midnight — behavior is consistent client-side. For accuracy across timezones, consider computing daysAway from a server-provided 'now' or use UTC uniformly.
